title: 6.3.9 Space Jumper
description: Build a one-sprite platformer: WASD moves, space jumps — but only when touching the ground.

steps.title: Set up the scene
steps.instructions: Create a canvas, enable gravity (world.gravity.y), add a dynamic player sprite, and a static ground sprite.
hints: Open the Sprite docs chapter (right drawer → Docs tab) for the constructor signature and collider types.

steps.title: Horizontal motion (WASD)
steps.instructions: In draw(), read kb.pressing('a') / kb.pressing('d') and set player.vel.x accordingly. Else-to-zero so the player doesn't drift.
hints: The Input docs chapter covers kb.pressing. Don't use arrow keys — they scroll the editor iframe.

steps.title: Ground-gated jump (kb.presses + colliding)
steps.instructions: Use kb.presses(' ') (edge-triggered, fires once per tap — pass a literal space character, the string 'space' will not match) AND player.colliding(ground). Only then set player.vel.y to a negative number.
hints: The Input docs explains the difference between kb.pressing and kb.presses. Use a literal space ' ' as the key — 'space' is not recognized.
The Collisions docs chapter covers .colliding() for per-frame contact checks (returns the frame count while the bodies are in contact, falsy when apart).

steps.title: Win condition
steps.instructions: Add a goal sprite the player can reach. When ship.overlaps(goal), trigger a clear win state — change the background, log a message, or stop updating.
hints: overlaps() is in the Collisions docs chapter. Boolean form is fine for a one-shot win check.

requirements.title: Static geometry exists
requirements.description: Create at least one sprite with collider 'static'

requirements.title: Player sprite exists
requirements.description: A dynamic Sprite is created in setup()

requirements.title: WASD horizontal input
requirements.description: Use kb.pressing with 'a' or 'd' inside draw()

requirements.title: Gravity enabled
requirements.description: Assign a positive value to world.gravity.y

requirements.title: Edge-triggered jump
requirements.description: Use kb.presses for the jump (not kb.pressing). Key arg must be a literal space ' ' or 'w'.

requirements.title: Win condition via overlap
requirements.description: Use .overlaps() somewhere — typically the goal-sprite check
